description: Continuous emission from one fixed point into a manufactured rising flow with procedural particle dispersion; no fluid solve.
visibility: 0 before emission, smooth activation after birth; Dot mode uses the visibility threshold

emission.slot_policy: fixed count and identity; hidden stationary slots at emitter until their birth

playback_note: Suggested 4-second playback is a DCC setting, not an absolute time encoded in FLD1. Endpoint hold; not a seamless loop.
reproducibility: Seed and settings retained; byte identity across NumPy/platform versions is not guaranteed.
distribution_status: Public FLD1 asset pack; distributed cache/settings/previews are CC0-1.0; no third-party source media.

suggested_playback.note: Host-side presentation suggestion; absolute presentation time is not encoded in FLD1.

suggested_view.note: Optional host-side starting orientation; not part of the FLD1 state contract.
